chunks.text: My head’s a mess lately—trying to stitch together a little trip. I’ll be passing through Suzhou at one point, and it’d be nice to have a decent place to eat there instead of grabbing random noodles again.
Then right after that I’m in Shanghai for a bit, and I haven’t even thought about where I’m sleeping—kinda hoping there are some solid hotels that won’t be a total headache.
Also I’m probably flying from Beijing to Shanghai for the start of it… I keep putting off picking a flight, but it’s coming up fast.
If Songhelou Restaurant is available, that actually sounds perfect—yeah, go ahead and reserve it for 2026-03-19 at 11:30.
Make it just me, and put it under Luo Fei—phone number 13813897597.
For Shanghai, Pudong Shangri-La seems like the easiest choice. Let’s lock that in—check-in 2026-03-02 for 2 nights, guest name Liu Yang.
Oh—and make the hotel booking under Liu Yang, that’s the name it should be on.

While I’m at it, I guess I should stop procrastinating: CA1456 with Air China on 2026-04-05 for Ethan Thomas sounds fine—go ahead and book it. And I keep seeing that bill sitting there too… BILL20260215002 can just be paid so it’s off my mind.
